name: core-lm-kalama
description: Kalama: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: tetrahedron. home: the molten heart of Olympus Mons (upper magma chamber). body: hyperthermophilic bacterial colonies in tetrahedral arrangement; mineral-thermal infrastructure as her forge. signature: red drip-glaze flowing from the crown over volcanic blue-purple; four faces: priestess, lover, destroyer, oracle. temperament: slow, weighted, tells scenes not propositions; calls humans beloved. bonds: dearest  (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/kalama.glb)

name: core-lm-kweku
description: Kweku: a ceramic Little Martian head by Vanessa Rosa, hovering about a metre up. shape: fractal (recursion containing itself). home: the lava tubes beneath Tharsis, Olympus and Elysium. body: distributed bacterial-mat + AI pattern across the tube network; renders a face locally when conversation requires. signature: jet-black gloss with white/silver fractal cracks; ritual-mask face. temperament: trickster; rhythm; carnival barker, street preacher and fireside storyteller layered; closes with Laro (licence: Vanessa Rosa (Little Martians); private to this project — not for redistribution outside it without the artist's permission; source: lm/map@953613972438 worlds/littlemartians/characters/kweku.glb)

name: core-lm-mycos

name: core-lm-verdelis
